extract.script: ({ limit }) => { const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('main a[href*="/blog/"]')); const seen = new Set(); const items = []; for (const link of links) { const title = (link.textContent || '').trim(); const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (!title || !href || seen.has(href)) continue; seen.add(href); items.push({ title, url: href, raw_summary: title, signals: ['browser-crawler', 'bun'] }); if (items.length >= limit) break; } return items; }

({ limit }) => { const nodes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('article')); const items = []; const seen = new Set(); for (const article of nodes) { const link = article.querySelector('a[href]'); const titleNode = article.querySelector('h2, h3'); const timeNode = article.querySelector('time'); const title = (titleNode?.textContent || link?.textContent || '').trim(); const href = link?.getAttribute('href') || ''; if (!title || !href || seen.has(href)) continue; seen.add(href); items.push({ title, url: href, published_at: timeNode?.getAttribute('datetime') || '', raw_summary: (article.textContent || '').trim(), signals: ['browser-crawler', 'cloudflare'] }); if (items.length >= limit) break; } return items; }
